Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC and Agile methodologies. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and debugging skills. Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify edge cases and failure scenarios. Ability to work independently and establish QA processes in a fast-paced environment. Good to Have Experience with React / Next.js / TanStack. Experience working in a startup or small development team. Experience as the sole or first QA professional in a team/organization. Experience with AI and model observability, including monitoring of latency, availability, token consumption, cost, retrieval quality, model responses, evaluation scores, safety events, and production drift. Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and cloud-native application design. Experience with test-driven development and automated testing using frameworks such as pytest, including unit, integration, API, workflow, evaluation, and end-to-end testing. Strong understanding of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, and secure software development practices for enterprise AI applications. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across application, AI model, agent, data, retrieval, and cloud infrastructure layers. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and software architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. High energy, a positive attitude, and a strong sense of ownership for delivering reliable and high-quality products. Below is the list of preferred experience: Experience developing enterprise applications using Java or Go. Experience with multiple agentic AI frameworks, particularly Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, and LangChain. Experience implementing Model Context Protocol-based integrations or similar standards for connecting AI agents with tools, data sources, and enterprise systems. Experience with vector databases or vector-enabled data platforms such as Amazon OpenSearch Service, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or equivalent technologies. Experience with orchestration and deployment platforms such as Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, Google Kubernetes Engine, or serverless compute services. Experience with model and experiment tracking, prompt management, evaluation platforms, tracing, and LLM observability tools. Experience designing event-driven or asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, or Google Pub/Sub. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or equivalent technologies. Familiarity with responsible AI practices covering fairness, transparency, explainability, privacy, human oversight, and risk management. Experience improving AI application performance through semantic caching, request batching, streaming, model routing, fallback strategies, and inference cost optimisation. Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or equivalent tools. Experience working in a SaaS product environment with multi-tenant architecture, enterprise identity, authorisation, auditability, and data-isolation requirements. Key Responsibilities Ensure the timely delivery of secure, reliable, and high-quality AI software that meets business requirements and maintains predictable performance in production environments. Design and develop cloud-native AI applications, agentic workflows, and reusable AI platform capabilities using Python, REST APIs, Large Language Models, and cloud services. Architect agent-based solutions using Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, LangChain, or related frameworks, selecting appropriate orchestration, state, memory, context, and multi-agent patterns. Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines covering ingestion, document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, re-ranking, grounding, citation, and response generation. Develop human-in-the-loop workflows that support review, approval, intervention, feedback, exception handling, and escalation for business-critical AI processes. Establish evaluation strategies and measurable quality criteria for agents, prompts, models, tools, and RAG pipelines, and integrate automated evaluations into the engineering lifecycle. Implement guardrails and security controls to reduce risks associated with prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, hallucinations, unauthorised tool usage, unsafe responses, and excessive agent autonomy. Optimise context usage, token consumption, latency, throughput, retrieval quality, model selection, and infrastructure cost while maintaining solution quality and reliability. Build and maintain REST APIs, asynchronous services, tool integrations, structured outputs, JSON schemas, and connectors required by AI agents and enterprise applications. Implement production monitoring and observability for AI applications, including application metrics, distributed traces, model interactions, agent execution paths, token usage, cost, evaluation outcomes, and safety events. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, incorporating automated testing, AI evaluations, dependency scanning, container scanning, policy checks, and deployment validation. Deploy and operate AI services on AWS or GCP using appropriate containerised, managed, or serverless deployment patterns. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, guiding architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, secure development, and operational best practices. Conduct thorough design and code reviews, ensuring that implementations meet software quality, security, testability, observability, maintainability, and responsible AI standards. Collaborate closely with engineering teams, product managers, architects, security teams, data specialists, and stakeholders to define technical solutions, delivery plans, success criteria, and operational requirements. Evaluate AI models, frameworks, tools, and cloud services through structured prototypes and technical assessments, and recommend technologies based on quality, security, scalability, operability, and cost. Troubleshoot complex production issues across agents, prompts, models, tool integrations, RAG pipelines, vector indexes, APIs, containers, and cloud infrastructure. Communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommended solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Stay current with developments in Generative AI, agentic frameworks, Large Language Models, cloud AI services, evaluation methodologies, and responsible AI, applying relevant advances to improve product capabilities and engineering practices. 7-12 Yrs Python, Rest, Artificial Intelligence

Build and own technology powering quick commerce at scale, across dark stores, inventory, order fulfilment and last-mile delivery. Build scalable products using Go (Golang), React and AWS, from architecture through production. Strong HLD/LLD and system design skills, with a good understanding of scalability, data modelling, failure handling and performance. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, with the ability to use AI to ship faster without compromising code quality. Strong engineering discipline around clean code, testing, automation and production reliability. What you'll get: Opportunity to be part of a tight-knit rocketship passionate about empowering consumer brands in the quick commerce era. Annual company retreat. Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and Foundation Models (FMs) with enterprise data sources through grounding modules, vector similarity search, and semantic search. Build Knowledge Graphs and ontologies to model enterprise domains and link contextual data for reasoning and relationship-aware GenAI applications. Develop LangChain / LangGraph-based orchestration pipelines for prompt templating, retrieval, generation, and post-processing. Implement data-masking, content filtering, and schema-based output parsing to ensure compliance, privacy, and structured response formats. Collaborate with development teams using SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model to embed AI capabilities into cloud-native applications. Work with multitenant SaaS architectures ensuring secure tenant isolation and hyperscaler-agnostic deployments. Employ chunking, embedding generation, and vector store management to enable efficient information retrieval and contextualization. Optimize orchestration pipelines to handle prompt templating, query rewriting, and fusion techniques (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) for enhanced retrieval precision. Lead end-to-end lifecycle of GenAI projectsfrom model integration and fine-tuning in AI Core to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Collaborate and manage cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions on time and within scope. Map business requirements to AI-powered solution architectures. Mentor and upskill team members through knowledge-sharing sessions and best practice frameworks. Ensure solution scalability, performance, and responsible AI usage principles are embedded throughout the development lifecycle. Track and report project progress, ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives. Professional Technical Skills: Deep understanding of SAP BTP services especially AI Core, Generative AI Hub, HANA Cloud (Vector Engine and Knowledge Graph Engine). Expertise with Large Language Models, Foundation Models, and LLM Orchestration Frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or Semantic Kernel. Hands-on experience designing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with embedding, chunking, and vector similarity search. Proficiency in Knowledge Graph design, GraphRAG, and ontology modelling using SAP HANA Cloud or graph databases. Strong grasp of data grounding, semantic enrichment, and enterprise contextualization. Experience with schema-based output parsing, prompt templating, and prompt-engineering best practices AI evaluation frameworks. Familiarity with content filtering, data masking, and AI governance / compliance frameworks in enterprise environments. Working knowledge of CAP (Cloud Application Programming model) and SAP Extension Suite for integrating GenAI into enterprise apps. Understanding of vector stores, vector search, and semantic search APIs in HANA Cloud. Exposure to multi-tenant SaaS architecture, hyperscaler-agnostic deployments, and MLOps pipelines for AI solutions. Have handled deployment of large-scale SAP applications, infrastructure, data, integrations, and related systems. Expertise in application design principles, cloud-native development, and integration within SAP ecosystem. Familiarity with integration techniques and tools within the SAP ecosystem. Strong understanding of application design principles and methodologies. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. Ability to analyze and optimize application performance. Additional Information: Sr. Manager:16+ years of experience as solution architect driving SAP BTP Gen AI initiatives. Completed minimum of 15 years of full-time education with Bachelors or Masters (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA) in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics Communication from a recognized institution. Experience in Agentic development with A2A protocol with MCP server. Working knowledge of RDF, SPARQL, OWL or equivalent graph technologies. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or SAP Continuous Integration Delivery). Knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and tracing AI requests through pipelines. Experience deploying AI workloads with Terraform / BTP CLI / Kyma Runtime automation. Awareness of Responsible AI principles:transparency, explainability, fairness, and privacy. Qualification 15 years full time education 15-20 Yrs SAP, Business process management, Architecture, Program, Graph, DBMS, SAP Hana, Docker
